openers.prompt_en: After a school match, Aarav notices that some cricket balls bounce higher than others. Which question could he test: A) Which ball looks best? B) Does a ball bounce higher on concrete than on grass?
openers.prompt_hi: School match ke baad Aarav notice karta hai ki kuch cricket balls zyada oonchi uchhalti hain. Kaunsa sawaal test kar sakta hai: A) Kaunsi ball sabse achchhi dikhti hai? B) Ball concrete par grass se zyada oonchi uchhalti hai kya?
hints: Kis sawaal ka jawab naapkar mil sakta hai?
Pasand aur dekhi ja sakne wali cheez mein farq socho.
Jis sawaal ko test kar sakte hain, woh option ___ hai.
B: dono surfaces par ball ki bounce compare ki ja sakti hai.

verified.solverAnswer: B) Does a ball bounce higher on concrete than on grass?

openers.prompt_en: Two identical wet sports jerseys are hung at the same time, one under a fan and one in still air. Based on what moving air does, which jersey do you predict will dry first: fan or still air?
openers.prompt_hi: Do ek jaisi geeli sports jerseys ek saath latkaayi gayi hain—ek fan ke neeche, doosri bina hawa wali jagah. Chalti hawa ke baare mein jo jaante ho, usse predict karo: kaunsi pehle sookhegi, fan wali ya bina hawa wali?
hints: Geeli jersey ke paas ki hawa badalne se kya hoga?
Chalti hawa sookhne par asar daalti hai.
Meri prediction hai ki ___ wali jersey pehle sookhegi.
Fan wali: chalti hawa paani ko jaldi evaporate karne mein madad karti hai.

harder.prompt_en: A class notices that phone batteries drain at different speeds. To test whether screen brightness affects battery drain, which question is better: A) Which phone brand is best? B) Does higher screen brightness make the same phone's battery drain faster?
harder.prompt_hi: Class notice karti hai ki phone batteries alag speed se khatam hoti hain. Screen brightness ka asar test karne ke liye kaunsa sawaal behtar hai: A) Kaunsa phone brand best hai? B) Kya ek hi phone ki brightness badhane se battery jaldi khatam hoti hai?
hints: Kis sawaal mein ek cheez badalkar nateeja dekh sakte ho?
Phone wahi rakho; jis cheez ka asar jaanchna hai, use badlo.
Behtar testable sawaal option ___ hai.
B: ek hi phone par brightness badalkar battery drain compare kar sakte hain.

verified.solverAnswer: B) Does higher screen brightness make the same phone's battery drain faster?

harder.prompt_en: A kabaddi team finds that its water bottles feel warmer in direct sun than in shade. Before testing, which prediction has a reason: A) The shaded bottle stays cooler because it receives less sunlight. B) The shaded bottle stays cooler because I like blue bottles?
harder.prompt_hi: Kabaddi team ko lagta hai ki dhoop mein rakhi water bottles, chhaon wali bottles se garam hain. Test se pehle kaunsi prediction wajah ke saath hai: A) Chhaon wali bottle thandi rahegi kyunki use kam dhoop milti hai. B) Woh thandi rahegi kyunki mujhe blue bottles pasand hain?
hints: Kaunsi wajah bottle ke garam hone se judi hai?
Prediction ki wajah pehle se jaane hue sambandh par honi chahiye.
Wajah wali prediction option ___ hai.
A: kam sunlight milne ki wajah bottle ke temperature se judi hai.

verified.solverAnswer: A) The shaded bottle stays cooler because it receives less sunlight.

harder.prompt_en: A class observes that a metro-platform puddle disappears, asks whether sunlight speeds drying, predicts yes, tests two similar puddles, and concludes the sunny one dried first. To continue finding out, what comes next: A) ask a new question or B) erase the result?
harder.prompt_hi: Class dekhti hai ki metro platform ka paani sookh gaya. Woh sunlight par sawaal, prediction aur do milte-julte puddles ka test karti hai; dhoop wala pehle sookhta hai. Ab khoj jaari rakhne ke liye kya kare: A) naya sawaal poochhe ya B) result mita de?
hints: Nateeja milne ke baad khoj kaise aage badhegi?
Science ki prakriya nateeje par hamesha khatam nahi hoti.
Agla kadam option ___ hai.
A: nateeje se naya sawaal uth sakta hai.

openers.prompt_en: Meera checks how warm her lunch stays. She records its temperature at 12:00 and 12:30. What two column headings, including a unit where needed, should her table have?
openers.prompt_hi: Meera check karti hai ki lunch kitna garam rehta hai. Woh 12:00 aur 12:30 par temperature note karti hai. Table ke do column headings kya honge? Jahan zaroori ho, unit bhi likho.
hints: Har reading ke saath Meera ne kaunsi do baatein note ki?
Headings data ka naam batate hain; measurement ke saath unit likho.
Pehla column ___; doosra column ___ (___).
Time | Temperature (°C): isse har reading aur uski unit clear hai.

openers.prompt_en: Arjun compares how quickly two phone cables charge the same phone. He uses the same charger and starts at 20% each time. What one thing should he measure after 10 minutes?
openers.prompt_hi: Arjun compare karta hai ki do phone cables same phone ko kitni jaldi charge karti hain. Charger same hai aur har baar 20% se shuru karta hai. 10 minute baad use kya measure karna chahiye?
hints: Kaunsa result batayega ki charging kitni hui?
Dono trials mein ek hi samay baad phone ki reading dekho.
10 minute baad phone par dikhne wala ___ note karo.
Battery percentage: isse dono cables ka charging result compare hoga.

harder.prompt_en: A school team tests three water filters. For each filter, they record the time taken for 200 mL of water to pass through: 45, 70 and 55 seconds. What two column headings make these readings clear?
harder.prompt_hi: School team teen water filters test karti hai. Har filter se 200 mL paani guzarne ka time 45, 70 aur 55 seconds hai. In readings ke liye do clear column headings kya honge?
hints: Ek row ko doosri row se kaise pehchanoge?
Ek heading filter bataye; doosri measured quantity aur unit.
Pehla column ___; doosra column ___ (___).
Filter | Time taken (seconds): headings filter aur measured time dono batate hain.

harder.prompt_en: To test whether a cricket ball bounces higher on grass or concrete, choose the fair plan. Plan A: use the same ball, drop it from 1 m, and measure bounce height on each surface. Plan B: change the ball and drop height too.
harder.prompt_hi: Check karna hai ki cricket ball grass ya concrete par zyada oonchi bounce hoti hai. Fair plan chuno. Plan A: same ball ko 1 m se giraakar dono surfaces par bounce height measure karo. Plan B: ball aur drop height bhi badlo.
hints: Kis plan mein surfaces ka comparison saaf hoga?
Ball aur drop height same rakhne se surface ka effect jaan sakte ho.
Fair plan ___ hai, kyunki sirf surface badalti hai.
Plan A: sirf surface badalti hai; ball aur drop height same rehte hain.

harder.prompt_en: In a fair test, the same paper plane is launched from the same mark three times. Its flight distances differ slightly. Why repeat the launches instead of trusting the first distance?
harder.prompt_hi: Fair test mein same paper plane ko same mark se teen baar launch kiya. Har baar distance thoda alag aaya. Sirf pehli reading par bharosa karne ke bajay launches repeat kyun karte hain?
harder.answer: To reduce the effect of chance variation and get a more reliable result.
acceptable: to get a more reliable result
because one launch may be unusual
chance variation ka asar kam karne ke liye
hints: Kya ek launch hamesha aam result dikhata hai?
Har launch mein chhote, anchahe farq aa sakte hain.
Kai readings se kisi ek unusual reading ka asar ___ hota hai.
Repetition chance variation ka asar kam karti hai, isliye result zyada reliable hota hai.

verified.solverAnswer: To get a reliable average and reduce error.

openers.prompt_en: In a school garden, a spinach stem is green and bends when pressed. A jasmine stem is brown and stays firm. Which plant has a woody stem: spinach or jasmine?
openers.prompt_hi: School garden mein palak ka tana hara hai aur dabane par mudta hai. Chameli ka tana bhoora hai aur sakht rehta hai. Woody tana kiska hai—palak ya chameli?
hints: Which stem stays firm when pressed?
A woody stem is hard rather than soft.
The firm, brown stem belongs to ___.
Jasmine: its brown stem stays firm, showing it is woody.

openers.prompt_en: A plant beside the school gate has several hard, woody stems branching close to the ground. Is it a herb, shrub or tree?
openers.prompt_hi: School gate ke paas ek paudhe mein kai sakht, lakdi jaise tane zameen ke paas se shaakhaein banate hain. Yeh herb, shrub ya tree hai?
hints: Where do its branches begin?
Use both the woody stems and branching position.
Woody stems branching near the ground indicate a ___.
Shrub: its woody stems branch close to the ground.

harder.prompt_en: Two new plants in a science club are equally short. Plant A has a soft green stem; Plant B has a hard woody stem. Can equal height alone show that both stems are the same type? Answer yes or no.
harder.prompt_hi: Science club ke do naye paudhe barabar chhote hain. Plant A ka tana naram aur hara hai; Plant B ka sakht aur lakdi jaisa. Kya sirf barabar height se dono tanon ka type same keh sakte hain? Haan ya nahin?
hints: Does their height describe what their stems feel like?
Compare the given stem properties, not just height.
Equal height does ___ prove equal stem type.
No: one stem is soft, while the other is woody.

harder.prompt_en: A young plant at a Pune nursery is only 40 cm tall. It has one hard woody main stem, with branches starting well above the ground. Choose its group from herb, shrub or tree; do not decide by height alone.
harder.prompt_hi: Pune ki nursery mein ek naya paudha sirf 40 cm lamba hai. Uska ek sakht, lakdi jaisa main tana hai, aur shaakhaein zameen se kaafi upar shuru hoti hain. Herb, shrub ya tree mein se chuno; sirf height mat dekho.
hints: How many main stems does it have?
Notice where branches begin on its woody stem.
One woody main stem with higher branches suggests a ___.
Tree: its single woody main stem branches well above the ground.

harder.prompt_en: A pumpkin vine has a weak stem. One part reaches a fence, while another grows across open soil. Which part is likely to climb: the part by the fence or the part on open soil?
harder.prompt_hi: Kaddu ki bel ka tana kamzor hai. Ek hissa baad tak pahunchta hai, aur doosra khuli mitti par badhta hai. Kaunsa hissa chadhega—baad ke paas wala ya khuli mitti wala?
hints: Which part has something to hold onto?
A weak stem needs support to grow upward.
The part beside the ___ can climb.
The part by the fence: the fence supports its weak stem.

openers.prompt_en: A student traces the veins on a mango leaf. Smaller veins branch from the middle vein and join one another. Is its venation reticulate or parallel?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek student aam ki patti ki nasein trace karta hai. Chhoti nasein beech wali nas se nikal kar aapas mein judti hain. Iska venation reticulate hai ya parallel?
hints: What happens when the smaller veins meet?
Think about the pattern made by joining veins.
Joining veins make a ___ pattern.
Reticulate: the joining veins form a net-like pattern.

openers.prompt_en: While clearing a school garden, Meera finds a plant with one thick main root and smaller roots branching from it. Does it have a tap root or fibrous roots?
openers.prompt_hi: School garden saaf karte waqt Meera ko ek paudha milta hai jisme ek moti main root hai aur usse chhoti roots nikalti hain. Ismein tap root hai ya fibrous roots?
hints: Is there one main root or a bunch of similar roots?
Focus on the thick root from which others branch.
A root system with one thick main root is called ___.
Tap root: smaller roots branch from one main root.

harder.prompt_en: Two leaves have long veins. In leaf A, smaller veins cross and join them; in leaf B, veins run alongside one another without joining. Which leaf has parallel venation: A or B?
harder.prompt_hi: Do pattiyon mein lambi nasein hain. Patti A mein chhoti nasein unhein kaatkar judti hain; patti B mein nasein bina jude ek-doosre ke saath chalti hain. Parallel venation kis patti mein hai: A ya B?
hints: Which leaf’s veins stay alongside one another?
Crossing and joining distinguishes the other pattern.
Veins that stay alongside one another are in leaf ___.
B: its veins run alongside one another without joining.

harder.prompt_en: At a school plant survey, pot A has many similarly thin roots from the stem base. Pot B has one main root with branches. Which pot has fibrous roots: A or B?
harder.prompt_hi: School plant survey mein pot A ke stem ke base se kai lagbhag ek-jaisi patli roots nikalti hain. Pot B mein branches wali ek main root hai. Fibrous roots kis pot mein hain: A ya B?
hints: Which pot lacks one distinct main root?
Look for a cluster of similarly thin roots.
The pot with many similar roots is ___.
A: fibrous roots form a cluster without one main root.

harder.prompt_en: A new garden plant has leaves whose small veins join to form a net. Before digging it up, predict its usual root type: tap root or fibrous roots?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek naye garden plant ki pattiyon mein chhoti nasein judkar jaal banati hain. Use khodne se pehle uski aam taur par root type predict karo: tap root ya fibrous roots?
hints: First, identify the leaf-vein pattern.
Recall which root type usually goes with that pattern.
Net-like venation usually goes with a ___.
Tap root: net-like venation usually goes with a main root.

openers.prompt_en: A wild crab lives among mangrove roots on a muddy coast flooded by seawater at high tide. Which is its habitat: a tidal coast or a dry field?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek jangli crab mangrove ki jadon ke beech kichad wale samundari kinare par rehta hai, jahan high tide par paani aa jata hai. Uska habitat kya hai: tidal coast ya sookha khet?
hints: Where does the crab regularly find what it needs?
A habitat is its usual living place, not just any nearby place.
Its usual living place is the ___.
Tidal coast: the crab lives among roots there.

openers.prompt_en: A water hyacinth floats in a school pond. Its leaf stalks contain air spaces. What do these spaces help it do: float or grip the pond floor?
openers.prompt_hi: School ke pond mein water hyacinth tairta hai. Uski leaf stalks mein hawa ki jagah hoti hai. Ye jagah use kya karne mein madad karti hai: tairne mein ya pond ki tali pakadne mein?
hints: What happens when air is trapped inside something in water?
Connect the stalk's structure to the plant's position in the pond.
Air spaces help the plant ___.
Float: air spaces help keep the plant at the surface.

harder.prompt_en: A reed grows naturally beside a freshwater lake near Bhopal. A student cuts one stem and keeps it in a classroom vase for a day. What is the reed's natural habitat: the lakeside or the classroom?
harder.prompt_hi: Bhopal ke paas ek freshwater lake ke kinare reed apne aap ugta hai. Ek student uska stem kaatkar ek din ke liye classroom ke vase mein rakhta hai. Reed ka natural habitat kya hai: lake ka kinara ya classroom?
hints: Where was the reed growing before it was cut?
Distinguish where an organism normally grows from where a piece is kept.
The reed's natural habitat is the ___.
The lakeside: it grows there naturally; the vase holds only a cut stem.

harder.prompt_en: A desert fox has large ears with many blood vessels. In the hot Thar Desert, how can these ears help it survive? Answer with one short phrase.
harder.prompt_hi: Desert fox ke bade kaanon mein bahut blood vessels hoti hain. Garam Thar Desert mein ye kaan use zinda rehne mein kaise madad karte hain? Ek chhote phrase mein batao.
hints: What challenge does a fox face in a hot desert?
Think about what blood near a large surface can do.
The ears help the fox ___ body heat.
They release body heat, helping the fox stay cool.

harder.prompt_en: After one snowy winter in Ladakh, does a goat grow a new inherited thick-fur adaptation because it needs one, or can such adaptations develop over many generations? Choose one.
harder.prompt_hi: Ladakh mein ek barfili sardi ke baad, kya bakri zaroorat padne par ek naya inherited thick-fur adaptation bana leti hai, ya aise adaptations kai generations mein develop ho sakte hain? Ek chuno.
harder.answer: Adaptations can develop over many generations.
hints: Can needing a feature change what an animal passes to its young?
An individual's response to weather differs from an inherited adaptation.
Inherited adaptations can develop over ___.
Many generations: one goat cannot choose a new inherited adaptation in one winter.

verified.solverAnswer: such adaptations develop over many generations

openers.prompt_en: In a pond, small fish eat algae and larger fish eat small fish. If the algae disappear, which fish will lose its food first: small fish or larger fish?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek talab mein chhoti machhliyan algae khati hain, aur badi machhliyan chhoti machhliyan khati hain. Agar algae gayab ho jaaye, toh pehle kiski khuraak khatam hogi: chhoti ya badi machhliyon ki?
hints: Which fish eats the missing thing directly?
Follow the food links one at a time.
Algae → ___ → larger fish.
Small fish lose food first because they eat algae directly.

openers.prompt_en: Lizards on a school terrace eat mosquitoes. If the lizards disappear but nothing else changes, will the number of mosquitoes likely increase or decrease?
openers.prompt_hi: School ki chhat par chipkaliyan machchhar khati hain. Agar chipkaliyan gayab ho jaayein aur baaki sab waisa hi rahe, toh machchharon ki sankhya badhegi ya ghategi?
hints: What happens when fewer animals eat the mosquitoes?
Think about how a predator affects its prey.
With fewer predators, mosquito numbers may ___.
Increase: fewer lizards would eat the mosquitoes.

harder.prompt_en: Squirrels carry tree seeds away and bury some. They forget a few, which later sprout. Why might more young trees grow away from the parent tree when squirrels are present?
harder.prompt_hi: Gilhariyan ped ke beej door le jaakar kuch daba deti hain. Kuch beej bhool jaati hain, jo baad mein ugte hain. Gilhariyan hone par naye ped parent tree se door kyon ug sakte hain?
harder.answer: Squirrels spread seeds away from the parent tree
acceptable: they carry and bury seeds elsewhere
hints: Where do the forgotten seeds end up?
Connect where a seed is left with where it sprouts.
Seeds carried away can sprout ___.
Squirrels spread seeds away from the parent tree, where they can sprout.

verified.solverAnswer: Squirrels disperse seeds to new locations.

harder.prompt_en: On a farm, grasshoppers eat plants and mynas eat grasshoppers. A spray kills most grasshoppers. If mynas cannot find other food, will their number likely increase or decrease over time?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek khet mein tidde paudhe khate hain aur maina tidde khati hai. Spray se zyaadatar tidde mar gaye. Agar maina ko doosra khaana na mile, toh samay ke saath unki sankhya badhegi ya ghategi?
hints: Which animal eats the insects affected by the spray?
Trace how losing prey affects its predator.
Less prey means the predator population may ___.
Decrease: mynas would have less food.

harder.prompt_en: A school wants to protect the variety of insects and birds on its grounds. Which plan is better: plant several local flowering shrubs and keep fallen leaves in one corner, or pave the ground and place plastic flowers?
harder.prompt_hi: School apne maidan mein keede aur pakshiyon ki variety bachana chahta hai. Kaunsa plan behtar hai: kai local phooldar jhaadiyan lagana aur ek kone mein gire patte rehne dena, ya zameen pakki karke plastic phool rakhna?
harder.answer: Plant local flowering shrubs and keep fallen leaves
hints: Which plan offers living things food and shelter?
Consider what insects need and what birds may eat.
The better plan includes plants and ___.
Plant local shrubs and keep leaves; they support insects and birds.

verified.solverAnswer: plant several local flowering shrubs and keep fallen leaves in one corner

openers.prompt_en: A school food chart lists carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins and minerals. It has two blank spaces for other components our body needs from food. What should go in the blanks?
openers.prompt_hi: School ke food chart mein carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins aur minerals likhe hain. Do khaali jagah aur hain, khaane se milne wali zaroori cheezon ke liye. Wahan kya likhoge?
hints: Which needed components are missing from this list?
Think beyond nutrients: digestion and hydration matter too.
Write the digestion-related component and the hydration-related component: ___ and ___.
Dietary fibre and water: they help digestion and keep the body hydrated.

openers.prompt_en: After kabaddi practice, Aarav needs food that helps repair body tissues. Which nutrient has this main role: protein, vitamin C or water?
openers.prompt_hi: Kabaddi practice ke baad Aarav ko aisa khaana chahiye jo body tissues ki repair mein madad kare. Yeh mukhya kaam kis ka hai: protein, vitamin C ya water?
hints: Which option is linked with building and repairing the body?
Choose by the nutrient’s main role, not by a favourite food.
The body-building nutrient is ___.
Protein helps the body build and repair tissues.

harder.prompt_en: A fitness app lists only carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins and minerals as components of food. Meera says the list is incomplete even though it names all five nutrients. Which two components has it left out?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek fitness app food components mein sirf carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins aur minerals dikhata hai. Meera kehti hai list adhuri hai, halaanki paanchon nutrients likhe hain. Kaun se do components chhoot gaye?
hints: Does every useful food component count among the five nutrients?
Recall what helps food pass through the gut and what hydrates you.
The two missing components are ___ and ___.
Dietary fibre and water are needed, though they are not among those five nutrients.

harder.prompt_en: A student says, ‘I ate enough rice for energy, so I don’t need dal.’ Why is rice alone not enough for growth and repair? Answer with the nutrient dal mainly adds.
harder.prompt_hi: Ek student kehta hai, ‘Energy ke liye maine kaafi chawal kha liye, isliye dal ki zaroorat nahi.’ Growth aur repair ke liye sirf chawal kaafi kyun nahi? Dal se mukhya taur par milne wala nutrient batao.
harder.answer: Dal adds protein, which helps growth and repair.
hints: Is getting energy the same as building body tissues?
Rice and dal mainly contribute different nutrients.
For growth and repair, dal mainly adds ___.
Dal adds protein, which helps the body grow and repair tissues.

verified.solverAnswer: Protein, because rice mainly provides carbohydrates not protein.

harder.prompt_en: For a school trek, a snack box has plain puffed rice, roasted chana and a small packet of ghee. Match each food to its main nutrient: carbohydrates, proteins or fats.
harder.prompt_hi: School trek ke snack box mein plain murmura, bhuna chana aur ghee ka chhota packet hai. Har food ko uske main nutrient se match karo: carbohydrates, proteins ya fats.
acceptable: puffed rice carbs, roasted chana protein, ghee fat
hints: What are the three foods mainly made from?
Compare a rice product, a pulse and an oily dairy product.
Puffed rice—___; roasted chana—___; ghee—___.
Puffed rice gives mainly carbohydrates, roasted chana proteins, and ghee fats.

verified.solverAnswer: puffed rice - carbohydrates, roasted chana - proteins, ghee - fats

openers.prompt_en: At a school food stall, you want to test an idli for starch. Which liquid should you add, and what colour would show starch is present?
openers.prompt_hi: School food stall par idli mein starch test karna hai. Kaunsa liquid daaloge, aur starch hone par kaunsa rang dikhega?
hints: Which test liquid did you use in the starch activity?
Think of the colour change after adding the test liquid.
Add dilute ___; starch makes it turn ___.
Dilute iodine turns blue-black when starch is present.

openers.prompt_en: You press a roasted cashew on paper and let the paper dry. What sign on the paper would show that the cashew contains fat?
openers.prompt_hi: Roasted cashew ko paper par dabakar paper sookhne dete ho. Paper par kya nishaan dikhne se pata chalega ki cashew mein fat hai?
acceptable: tel ka daag sookhne ke baad bhi rehta hai
hints: What should you check after the paper dries?
Compare the pressed spot with untouched paper.
Fat leaves a lasting ___ on paper.
A translucent oily patch remains after drying, showing fat.

harder.prompt_en: Riya tests two unlabelled lunch samples with dilute iodine. Sample A turns blue-black; sample B stays brown. Which sample contains starch, and which observation supports your choice?
harder.prompt_hi: Riya do bina label wale lunch samples mein dilute iodine daalti hai. Sample A neela-kaala ho jata hai; sample B brown rehta hai. Starch kis sample mein hai, aur kaunsi observation se pata chala?
hints: Which sample changed colour after iodine was added?
Use the starch test’s positive result, not iodine’s original colour.
Sample ___ contains starch because it turned ___.
Sample A contains starch because iodine turned blue-black.

verified.solverAnswer: Sample A; it turned blue-black with iodine.

harder.prompt_en: At a school nutrition display, a crushed seed leaves a patch after paper dries. In the teacher-run protein test, its paste turns violet. Name the two nutrients these results show.
harder.prompt_hi: School nutrition display mein kuchla hua beej paper sookhne ke baad bhi daag chhodta hai. Teacher ke protein test mein uska paste violet ho jata hai. In results se kaunse do nutrients pata chalte hain?
hints: Match each observation to its own test.
The paper and colour tests check different nutrients.
The lasting paper patch shows ___; violet shows ___.
The seed has fat and protein: the patch and violet colour show them.

harder.prompt_en: A new snack gives blue-black with iodine, leaves a patch on dry paper, and turns violet in the teacher-run protein test. Which claim fits: ‘only starch’, ‘starch and fat’, or ‘starch, fat and protein’?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek naye snack par iodine neela-kaala hota hai, sookhe paper par daag rehta hai, aur teacher ke protein test mein violet rang aata hai. Kaunsa claim sahi hai: ‘sirf starch’, ‘starch aur fat’, ya ‘starch, fat aur protein’?
hints: How many different tests gave positive results?
Each test provides evidence about a different nutrient.
Iodine shows ___, paper shows ___, and violet shows ___.
Starch, fat and protein: all three tests gave positive results.

openers.prompt_en: After football practice, Meera eats a paneer sandwich and drinks water. Which addition makes her snack more balanced: cucumber slices or another cheese slice?
openers.prompt_hi: Football practice ke baad Meera paneer sandwich khaati hai aur paani peeti hai. Snack ko zyada santulit kya banayega: kheere ke slices ya ek aur cheese slice?
hints: Which choice adds something different to the snack?
A balanced snack needs variety, including fibre.
The sandwich has paneer; add ___ for fibre.
Cucumber slices add fibre and variety to the snack.

openers.prompt_en: A student rarely eats fresh fruit and has bleeding gums. Which missing nutrient could explain this: vitamin C or iron?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek student taaze phal kam khaata hai aur uske masoodon se khoon aata hai. Kis poshak tatva ki kami ho sakti hai: vitamin C ya iron?
hints: Which clue comes from the gums?
Think of the nutrient supplied by many fresh fruits.
Bleeding gums can point to a lack of ___.
Vitamin C deficiency can cause bleeding gums.

harder.prompt_en: At a school camp, lunch is chapatis, dal, sabzi and water. Which addition better completes a balanced meal: a guava or extra chapatis? Give the main reason.
harder.prompt_hi: School camp mein lunch mein chapati, dal, sabzi aur paani hai. Santulit meal ke liye kya behtar hai: amrood ya extra chapati? Mukhya wajah batao.
harder.answer: Guava; it adds vitamins and fibre rather than more of the same food.
acceptable: amrood, vitamins aur fibre ke liye
hints: What does the meal already get from chapatis?
Look for nutrients that add variety.
Choose ___ because it adds ___ rather than more chapatis.
Guava adds vitamins and fibre; extra chapatis mainly add more carbohydrates.

harder.prompt_en: A doctor says Arjun’s tiredness is linked to iron-deficiency anaemia. For his regular meals, which is the better addition: spinach and chickpeas or extra plain rice?
harder.prompt_hi: Doctor kehte hain Arjun ki thakaan iron ki kami se hone wale anaemia se judi hai. Roz ke khane mein kya behtar jode: palak aur chane ya extra saada chawal?
hints: Which option supplies the missing mineral?
Match the doctor’s finding to foods containing that mineral.
Add ___ and ___ to help supply iron.
Spinach and chickpeas supply iron, which his diet needs.

harder.prompt_en: A Jaipur school wants a balanced lunch featuring a grain that can grow with less water. Choose ragi roti with dal, vegetables and curd, or plain rice with pickle. Why?
harder.prompt_hi: Jaipur ka school aisa santulit lunch chahta hai jismein kam paani mein ugne wala anaj ho. Chuno: ragi roti, dal, sabzi aur dahi; ya saada chawal aur achaar. Kyun?
harder.answer: Ragi roti with dal, vegetables and curd; ragi needs less water, and the other foods add a variety of nutrients.
acceptable: ragi meal; millet needs less water and the meal has varied nutrients
ragi roti, dal, sabzi aur dahi; kam paani aur alag poshak tatva
hints: Which grain suits a place where water matters?
Then check whether the whole meal includes varied food groups.
Choose ___; its grain needs less water, while the sides add ___.
Choose the ragi meal: millet needs less water, and the sides add varied nutrients.

verified.solverAnswer: ragi roti with dal, vegetables and curd

openers.prompt_en: Tomatoes for a Pune school canteen travel 30 km from a farm to a wholesale market, then 12 km to the canteen. What are their food miles along this route?
openers.prompt_hi: Pune ke school canteen ke tamatar farm se wholesale market tak 30 km, phir canteen tak 12 km aate hain. Is route par unke food miles kitne hain?
hints: Where does the journey start, and where does it end?
Count both parts of the food’s journey.
Total distance = 30 km + ___ km.
42 km: add the two parts of the route.

openers.prompt_en: A Bengaluru café buys carrots from two farms. Farm A sends them 80 km; Farm B sends them 230 km. If both use similar vans, which delivery is likely to use less fuel?
openers.prompt_hi: Bengaluru ka ek café do farms se gajar mangata hai. Farm A se 80 km aur Farm B se 230 km ka safar hai. Dono ki vans milti-julti hain. Kis delivery mein fuel kam lagne ki sambhavana hai?
hints: Which van has the shorter journey?
With similar vans, compare their travel distances.
The shorter distance is ___ km.
Farm A: its van travels the shorter distance.

harder.prompt_en: A snack packet bought in Delhi says ‘Potatoes grown in Punjab; packed in Haryana’. It travelled 220 km to the packing unit and another 90 km to the shop. What distance should you count for its food miles?
harder.prompt_hi: Delhi mein kharide snack packet par likha hai: ‘Aloo Punjab mein uge; packing Haryana mein hui.’ Packing unit tak 220 km aur wahan se dukaan tak 90 km ka safar hua. Food miles ke liye kitni doori ginoge?
hints: Did the journey begin at the packing unit?
Include travel before and after packing.
Total distance = 220 km + ___ km.
310 km: count the journey from where the potatoes grew.

harder.prompt_en: A Hyderabad shop receives grapes from a nearby farm and from a farm 1,000 km away. Both arrive by similar trucks. Why is the distant delivery likely to cause more transport pollution?
harder.prompt_hi: Hyderabad ki dukaan mein paas ke farm aur 1,000 km door ke farm se angoor aate hain. Dono milte-julte trucks se aate hain. Door wali delivery se transport pollution zyada hone ki sambhavana kyun hai?
harder.answer: The longer truck journey is likely to burn more fuel.
acceptable: It travels farther and uses more fuel
zyada doori se zyada fuel lagta hai
hints: What changes between the two truck journeys?
Think about fuel used while a truck travels.
A longer journey is likely to need more ___.
The distant truck likely burns more fuel, causing more pollution.

verified.solverAnswer: It travels a much longer distance, burning more fuel.

harder.prompt_en: In winter, a Jaipur school wants to reduce food miles but still serve fruit. Choose the better plan: ‘use nearby seasonal fruit when available’ or ‘serve only nearby fruit all year’. Which plan recognises a limit of buying local?
harder.prompt_hi: Sardiyon mein Jaipur ka school food miles kam karna chahta hai, par fruit bhi dena hai. Kaunsa plan local kharidne ki seema samajhta hai: ‘jab mile, paas ka seasonal fruit lo’ ya ‘saal bhar sirf paas ka fruit do’?
harder.answer: Use nearby seasonal fruit when available
acceptable: jab mile paas ka seasonal fruit lo
hints: Will the same nearby fruits be available every season?
Consider what the school can do when local supplies change.
Choose the plan that says ‘when ___’.
Use nearby seasonal fruit when available: local choices vary by season.

verified.solverAnswer: use nearby seasonal fruit when available

openers.prompt_en: At a school exhibition, a magnet attracts badge A but not badge B. Which badge should be recorded as magnetic: A or B?
openers.prompt_hi: School exhibition mein magnet badge A ko attract karta hai, par badge B ko nahi. Magnetic ke roop mein kaunsa badge record karoge: A ya B?
hints: What happened when the magnet approached each badge?
Record the test result, not how a badge looks.
The attracted badge goes in the magnetic column: ___.
A; the magnet attracted that badge.

openers.prompt_en: A phone-repair kit has a copper wire and an iron screw. Which material belongs in its magnetic-materials tray: copper or iron?
openers.prompt_hi: Phone-repair kit mein copper ka taar aur iron ka screw hai. Magnetic materials wali tray mein kaunsa material jayega: copper ya iron?
hints: Which of these two metals can a magnet attract?
Being a metal alone does not make something magnetic.
The magnetic-materials tray gets the ___ item.
Iron; magnets attract iron but not copper.

harder.prompt_en: A magnet attracts three identical-looking game tokens. When each token is turned over and tested again, only tokens P and R are attracted. Which tokens have a consistent magnetic test result?
harder.prompt_hi: Magnet teen ek-jaise dikhne wale game tokens ko attract karta hai. Har token ko palatkar dobara test karne par sirf P aur R attract hote hain. Kin tokens ka magnetic test result dono baar ek jaisa hai?
hints: Which tokens were attracted in both tests?
Compare the first and second results for each token.
The tokens attracted both times are ___ and ___.
P and R; both were attracted in each test.

harder.prompt_en: A science-club box contains strips labelled nickel, aluminium, cobalt and brass. Which two strips should go in the magnetic-materials box?
harder.prompt_hi: Science club ke box mein nickel, aluminium, cobalt aur brass label wali strips hain. Magnetic materials wale box mein kaunsi do strips jayengi?
hints: Do all four named metals respond to magnets?
Sort by material, not by metallic appearance.
The two magnetic strips are ___ and ___.
Nickel and cobalt; aluminium and brass are not attracted.

harder.prompt_en: A recycling centre uses a magnet over mixed iron bottle caps and aluminium drink cans. Why does this separate them even though both are metal?
harder.prompt_hi: Recycling centre mein iron bottle caps aur aluminium drink cans ke mixture ke upar magnet chalaya jata hai. Dono metal hone par bhi ye alag kaise ho jate hain?
harder.answer: The magnet attracts iron but not aluminium.
acceptable: Iron is magnetic, but aluminium is not.
Only the iron caps are attracted.
Magnet iron ko attract karta hai, aluminium ko nahi.
hints: Must two different metals react alike to a magnet?
Think about each material’s response, not whether it is metal.
The magnet attracts ___ but leaves ___ behind.
It attracts iron, not aluminium; so the caps separate from the cans.

verified.solverAnswer: Iron is magnetic, aluminium is not.

openers.prompt_en: A bar magnet is inside a pencil case. You can test only spots A (left end), B (middle), and C (right end) with a steel paper clip. At which two spots should the clip stick most strongly?
openers.prompt_hi: Pencil case mein ek bar magnet hai. Tum steel paper clip se sirf A (left end), B (beech) aur C (right end) check kar sakte ho. Clip kin do spots par sabse mazbooti se chipkegi?
hints: Which parts of a bar magnet are its poles?
Compare the middle with the two outer parts.
The strongest spots are ___ and ___.
A and C: a bar magnet pulls most strongly at its poles.

openers.prompt_en: Two magnetic clasps on school bags have their north poles facing each other. When brought close, will they attract or repel?
openers.prompt_hi: Do school bags ke magnetic clasps ke north poles ek doosre ke saamne hain. Paas laane par ve attract karenge ya repel?
hints: Are the facing poles alike or different?
Think of the rule for matching poles.
These clasps will ___ each other.
Repel: like poles push away from each other.

harder.prompt_en: A magnetic strip behind a noticeboard is hidden. A steel pin sticks strongly near the strip’s top and bottom but barely at its centre. Where are the strip’s poles?
harder.prompt_hi: Noticeboard ke peeche magnetic strip chhupi hai. Steel pin strip ke top aur bottom ke paas mazbooti se chipakti hai, par centre par mushkil se. Strip ke poles kahan hain?
hints: Where does the pin stick most strongly?
Strongest attraction helps locate the poles.
The poles are near the ___ and ___.
Near the top and bottom: those spots attract the pin most strongly.

harder.prompt_en: In a school lab, a steel rod and an unlabelled magnet both attract a known magnet. Which result would prove the unlabelled object is a magnet: attraction to its north pole or repulsion from its north pole?
harder.prompt_hi: School lab mein steel rod aur bina label wala magnet, dono ek known magnet ko attract karte hain. Bina label wali cheez magnet hai, yeh kaunsa result prove karega: uske north pole se attraction ya repulsion?
acceptable: push away from its north pole
hints: Can ordinary steel also be attracted?
Look for an effect that ordinary steel cannot show here.
The proving result is ___ from the north pole.
Repulsion: unlike ordinary steel, a magnet can repel another magnet’s pole.

harder.prompt_en: During a lab accident, a bar magnet snaps into two pieces. Riya says one piece has only a north pole. Why is she wrong? Answer in a short phrase.
harder.prompt_hi: Lab mein ek bar magnet tootkar do tukde ho gaya. Riya kehti hai ki ek tukde mein sirf north pole hoga. Woh galat kyun hai? Chhote phrase mein batao.
harder.answer: Each piece has both a north and a south pole
acceptable: har tukde mein north aur south pole honge
new poles form at the broken ends
hints: What happens at a newly broken end?
A broken piece is still a complete magnet.
Each piece has a ___ and a ___ pole.
Each piece has north and south poles; new poles form at the breaks.

verified.solverAnswer: Each piece becomes a new magnet with both poles.

openers.prompt_en: At a school exhibition, a freely hanging magnet has stopped moving. Its blue end is marked N. Which direction is the blue end pointing: north or south?
openers.prompt_hi: School exhibition mein ek magnet dhaage se latak kar ruk gaya hai. Uska neela sira N marked hai. Neela sira kis disha mein hai: north ya south?
hints: What does the N mark tell you about that end?
Think about where a freely hanging magnet's marked pole settles.
The end marked N points towards ___.
North; a freely hanging magnet's N pole points roughly north.

openers.prompt_en: At a metro exit, your compass needle settles with its N end pointing towards the ticket counter. In which direction is the ticket counter: north or south?
openers.prompt_hi: Metro exit par compass needle ka N wala sira ticket counter ki taraf rukta hai. Ticket counter kis disha mein hai: north ya south?
hints: Which end of the needle faces the counter?
A compass's marked end helps identify a direction.
The counter lies in the direction shown by the ___ end.
North; the compass's N end points towards the counter.

harder.prompt_en: For a science display, Meera suspends a magnet freely, then turns it so its N pole faces west. After she lets go and it settles, which direction will the N pole face?
harder.prompt_hi: Science display ke liye Meera magnet ko dhaage se latkati hai, phir uska N pole west ki taraf modti hai. Chhodne ke baad jab magnet rukega, N pole kis disha mein hoga?
hints: Can the magnet stay pointing wherever Meera turns it?
Focus on its final position when it can turn freely.
After settling, the N pole faces ___.
North; a freely suspended magnet returns to its roughly north-south alignment.

harder.prompt_en: On a school hike, a compass shows north straight ahead. Your group must take the path to the west. Should you turn left or right?
harder.prompt_hi: School hike par compass ke mutabik north seedha aage hai. Group ko west wale raste par jaana hai. Left mudoge ya right?
hints: Picture yourself facing the direction the compass shows.
Work around the compass directions from your current facing.
To face west from this position, turn ___.
Left; west is to your left when you face north.

harder.prompt_en: In a school experiment, a magnetised needle floats on cork in water, away from metal objects. It settles roughly north-south. Why does it align this way: Earth's magnetism or the cork's colour?
harder.prompt_hi: School experiment mein magnetised needle cork par paani mein tair rahi hai, metal objects se door. Woh lagbhag north-south rukti hai. Aisa kyun hota hai: Earth ke magnetism ki wajah se ya cork ke colour se?
acceptable: Earth behaves like a giant magnet
Dharti ek bade magnet ki tarah hai
hints: Would changing the cork's colour change the needle's direction?
The needle is magnetised; think about what can affect magnets.
The needle aligns because of ___.
Earth's magnetism; Earth acts like a giant magnet.

openers.prompt_en: The school orders a 3 m banner, but the printer’s form asks for centimetres. What length should the school enter?
openers.prompt_hi: School 3 m ka banner order kar raha hai, lekin printer ka form centimetres mein length maangta hai. School kya length likhe?
hints: How many centimetres make one metre?
Use the same conversion for each metre of the banner.
Banner length in centimetres = 3 × ___.
300 cm; each of the three metres has 100 cm.

openers.prompt_en: A metro-card sleeve lies along a ruler. Its left edge is at 2 cm and its right edge is at 11 cm. What is its length?
openers.prompt_hi: Metro-card sleeve ruler ke saath rakha hai. Uska left edge 2 cm par aur right edge 11 cm par hai. Uski length kitni hai?
hints: Does the sleeve begin at the ruler’s zero mark?
Find the distance between its two edge readings.
Length = right-edge reading − ___.
9 cm; subtract the 2 cm starting reading from 11 cm.

harder.prompt_en: Two schools report their running tracks as 400 ‘paces’ each, but their pace lengths differ. Why should they report the lengths in metres instead?
harder.prompt_hi: Do schools apne running tracks ko 400 ‘paces’ batate hain, lekin unke pace ki length alag hai. Length metres mein batana behtar kyun hai?
harder.answer: A metre is a standard unit, so the lengths can be compared reliably.
acceptable: Metres have the same length everywhere
Paces vary, but metres do not
Standard units allow a fair comparison
hints: Can equal pace counts mean unequal distances?
Think about a unit whose size stays the same for everyone.
A common unit makes the two lengths ___ to compare.
Metres are standard, so the reported lengths can be compared reliably.

verified.solverAnswer: A metre is a standard unit; a pace is not.

harder.prompt_en: Ayaan measures a phone case with a ruler held along its edge and reads from directly above. Meera uses the same ruler but reads from the side. Whose reading is more reliable: Ayaan’s or Meera’s?
harder.prompt_hi: Ayaan ruler ko phone case ke edge ke saath rakhkar seedha upar se reading dekhta hai. Meera wahi ruler use karti hai, par side se dekhti hai. Kiski reading zyada bharosemand hai: Ayaan ki ya Meera ki?
hints: From which position might a mark appear shifted?
Your eye position affects how you see a ruler mark.
The more reliable reading is taken from directly ___.
Ayaan’s; looking directly above the mark avoids a shifted reading.

harder.prompt_en: For a school science display, Kavya joins a 1 m wire and a 25 cm wire end to end. What is their total length in millimetres?
harder.prompt_hi: School science display ke liye Kavya 1 m aur 25 cm ke do wires ko end to end jodti hai. Total length millimetres mein kitni hai?
acceptable: one thousand two hundred fifty millimetres
ek hazaar do sau pachaas millimetre
hints: Can you add the lengths before changing units?
Convert both wire lengths to the requested unit, then add.
Total in millimetres = ___ + (25 × 10).
1,250 mm; the wires measure 1,000 mm and 250 mm.

openers.prompt_en: A thread is laid along a curved line showing a cycle route and marked at both ends. When straightened beside a ruler, the marks line up with 2 cm and 11 cm. How long is the curved line?
openers.prompt_hi: Cycle route ki tedhi line par dhaaga bichhaakar dono ends par marks lagaye. Seedha karke ruler ke paas rakha, toh marks 2 cm aur 11 cm par aaye. Tedhi line kitni lambi hai?
hints: Which part of the thread followed the curve?
Measure between the two marks, not from the ruler’s zero.
Length = ending ruler reading − starting ruler reading = ___.
9 cm; subtract 2 cm from 11 cm.

openers.prompt_en: Meera wraps a thread once around a steel water bottle and marks where it meets its starting point. Straightened beside a ruler, the marked length is 24 cm. What is the distance around the bottle?
openers.prompt_hi: Meera steel water bottle ke chaaron taraf dhaaga ek baar lapetkar, jahan woh shuru wale point se milta hai, wahan mark lagati hai. Seedha karne par marked length 24 cm hai. Bottle ke chaaron taraf ki doori kitni hai?
hints: What did the wrapped part of the thread follow?
The marked length represents one complete round.
Distance around the bottle = marked thread length = ___.
24 cm; the marked thread made one complete round.

harder.prompt_en: Arjun stretches an elastic thread while laying it along a curved running-track drawing. He marks both ends, then lets the thread relax before measuring it. Will his measured length be too short or too long? Why?
harder.prompt_hi: Arjun running-track ki tedhi drawing par elastic dhaaga kheenchkar bichhata hai. Dono ends mark karke naapne se pehle dhaaga dheela chhod deta hai. Naapi hui length kam hogi ya zyada? Kyun?
harder.answer: Too short; the stretched thread shrinks when released.
acceptable: kam, kyunki dhaaga chhodne par sikudta hai
hints: What happens to elastic thread after you stop pulling it?
Compare its length while tracing with its length at the ruler.
After release, the distance between marks becomes ___, changing the reading.
Too short; the thread shrinks before it is measured.

verified.solverAnswer: Too short, because an elastic thread stretches when laid, then contracts when relaxed.

harder.prompt_en: For a school event, thread wrapped once around one drum measures 76 cm when straightened. Around a second drum it measures 91 cm. How much longer is the distance around the second drum?
harder.prompt_hi: School event ke liye pehle drum ke chaaron taraf ek baar lapeta dhaaga seedha karne par 76 cm hai. Doosre drum ke liye 91 cm hai. Doosre drum ke chaaron taraf ki doori kitni zyada hai?
hints: What does each straightened thread length tell you?
Compare the two distances around the drums.
Difference = second drum’s length − first drum’s length = ___.
15 cm; subtract 76 cm from 91 cm.

harder.prompt_en: On a metro-planning map, a thread laid along a curved route measures 7.5 cm when straightened. The map scale is 1 cm = 4 km. What is the route’s actual length?
harder.prompt_hi: Metro-planning map par tedhe route ke saath bichhaya dhaaga seedha karne par 7.5 cm hai. Map scale 1 cm = 4 km hai. Route ki asli length kitni hai?
hints: What real distance does each map centimetre represent?
Use the scale for the entire straightened thread length.
Actual distance = map length × kilometres per centimetre = ___.
30 km; multiply 7.5 by 4.

openers.prompt_en: At a school event, a camera stays on a tripod while Kabir walks past it. Using the tripod as the reference point, is Kabir at rest or in motion?
openers.prompt_hi: School event mein camera tripod par ek jagah rakha hai aur Kabir uske paas se chalta hai. Tripod ko reference point maankar, Kabir rest mein hai ya motion mein?
hints: Does Kabir stay at the same distance from the tripod?
Compare his position with the chosen reference point.
His position relative to the tripod changes, so he is ___.
In motion: his position changes relative to the tripod.

openers.prompt_en: A metro station’s display board has a pointer that repeatedly moves left, then right, between two marks. Is the pointer’s motion linear, circular or oscillatory?
openers.prompt_hi: Metro station ke display board par ek pointer do nishanon ke beech baar-baar left, phir right jaata hai. Uski motion linear, circular ya oscillatory hai?
hints: Does the pointer keep going in one direction?
Notice that it repeatedly reverses direction between two limits.
Repeated movement between the two marks is ___ motion.
Oscillatory: it moves to and fro between two limits.

harder.prompt_en: Neha walks at the same pace beside a moving luggage trolley. Is the trolley at rest or in motion relative to Neha? Give the key reason.
harder.prompt_hi: Neha ek chalti luggage trolley ke saath usi speed se chal rahi hai. Neha ke reference mein trolley rest mein hai ya motion mein? Ek wajah batao.
harder.answer: At rest; its position relative to Neha does not change.
acceptable: rest; same position relative to Neha
sthir; Neha ke mukable jagah nahi badalti
hints: Does the gap between Neha and the trolley change?
Use Neha, not the ground, as the reference point.
The trolley is ___ because its position relative to Neha ___.
At rest: its position relative to Neha stays unchanged.

verified.solverAnswer: At rest relative to Neha; both move together with no change in relative position.

harder.prompt_en: A robot vacuum travels along the straight edge of a classroom, then turns around and travels back along that edge. Is its motion linear, circular or oscillatory? Choose the best description of its path.
harder.prompt_hi: Robot vacuum classroom ki seedhi deewar ke saath chalta hai, phir mudkar usi raaste se laut aata hai. Uske path ko linear, circular ya oscillatory mein se kaise describe karoge?
hints: What shape is the path it follows?
Classify the path, even though its direction changes.
A path along one straight edge is ___ motion.
Linear: both trips follow the same straight path.

harder.prompt_en: A bicycle rolls along a straight cycle track. Which two motions happen at once: linear and circular, linear and oscillatory, or circular and oscillatory?
harder.prompt_hi: Cycle seedhe cycle track par chal rahi hai. Ek saath kaunsi do motions ho rahi hain: linear aur circular, linear aur oscillatory, ya circular aur oscillatory?
hints: Look separately at the whole bicycle and its wheels.
The bicycle changes place while each wheel turns.
The whole bicycle shows ___ motion; the wheels show ___ motion.
Linear and circular: the bicycle travels straight while its wheels rotate.

openers.prompt_en: At a school exhibition, light passes through a coloured sheet, but you cannot read a label behind it. Is the sheet transparent, translucent or opaque?
openers.prompt_hi: School exhibition mein ek coloured sheet se roshni guzarti hai, lekin uske peeche ka label padh nahi paate. Sheet transparent, translucent ya opaque hai?
hints: Does light pass through the sheet?
Also check whether the label is clear.
Light passes through, but the label is unclear: ___.
Translucent: it lets light through without showing the label clearly.

openers.prompt_en: For a craft project, a steel key scratches a wax block, but the wax block cannot scratch the key. Which is harder: the key or the wax block?
openers.prompt_hi: Craft project mein steel ki chaabi wax block par kharonch banati hai, lekin wax block chaabi par nahi. Kaun zyada hard hai: chaabi ya wax block?
hints: Which object made a scratch?
A scratch test compares the hardness of two materials.
The object that scratched the other is ___.
The steel key is harder because it scratches the wax block.

harder.prompt_en: A polished steel lunchbox lid is shiny, yet you cannot see your food through it. Which pair describes the lid: lustrous and opaque, or lustrous and transparent?
harder.prompt_hi: Polished steel lunchbox ka dhakkan chamakdar hai, par uske aar-paar khana nahi dikhta. Kaunsi jodi sahi hai: lustrous aur opaque, ya lustrous aur transparent?
hints: Does shininess tell you whether you can see through something?
Judge shine and passage of light separately.
The lid is shiny and cannot be seen through: ___.
Lustrous and opaque: it shines, but you cannot see through it.

harder.prompt_en: Meera drops a plastic bottle cap and a spoonful of salt into a bucket of water, then stirs. What happens to each: does the cap float or sink, and does the salt dissolve or remain visible?
harder.prompt_hi: Meera paani ki balti mein plastic bottle cap aur ek chammach namak daalkar hilati hai. Cap float karega ya sink, aur namak ghulega ya dikhta rahega?
harder.answer: The cap floats; the salt dissolves.
acceptable: cap tairta hai, namak ghul jaata hai
hints: What would you check for each item?
Floating and dissolving are different tests.
The cap ___; the salt ___.
The cap floats; the stirred salt dissolves in water.

verified.solverAnswer: The cap floats, and the salt dissolves.

harder.prompt_en: Two unlabelled white powders look alike. Powder A disappears when stirred in water; powder B remains visible. Why is looking at the powders not enough to say they are the same material?
harder.prompt_hi: Do bina label ke safed powders ek jaise dikhte hain. Powder A paani mein hilane par gayab ho jaata hai; powder B dikhta rehta hai. Sirf dekhkar unhein ek hi material kyun nahi keh sakte?
harder.answer: Look-alike materials can have different properties; these powders differ in solubility.
acceptable: One dissolves and the other does not
Ek ghulta hai aur doosra nahi
hints: What did the water test show?
Compare their behaviour, not just their appearance.
They look alike, but differ in ___.
They differ in solubility, so their similar appearance is not enough.

verified.solverAnswer: Different materials can look the same but behave differently in water.

openers.prompt_en: A bicycle has a rubber tyre and a rubber brake pad. What is the shared material, rather than the name of either object?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek cycle mein rubber ka tyre aur rubber ka brake pad hai. Dono ka common material kya hai, object ka naam nahi?
hints: Which word tells you what both parts are made of?
Tyre and brake pad name parts; look for their shared substance.
Both parts are made of ___.
Rubber is the material; tyre and brake pad are objects.

openers.prompt_en: A school display has a clear acrylic sheet, frosted glass and cardboard. Which one belongs in the transparent group, through which you can see clearly?
openers.prompt_hi: School display mein clear acrylic sheet, frosted glass aur cardboard hain. Transparent group mein kaun sa aayega, jiske paar clearly dekh sakte hain?
hints: Could you read a sign through each material?
Transparent means you can see objects clearly through it.
The transparent item is the ___.
Clear acrylic sheet is transparent because you can see clearly through it.

harder.prompt_en: A phone-repair list reads: copper cable, copper, PVC coating, PVC. Which two entries name materials rather than parts?
harder.prompt_hi: Phone repair ki list mein hai: copper cable, copper, PVC coating, PVC. Kaun si do entries parts ke bajay materials ke naam hain?
hints: Which entries could be used to make several different parts?
Separate names of substances from names of made parts.
The two material names are ___ and ___.
Copper and PVC are materials; cable and coating name parts.

harder.prompt_en: A science fair needs materials that are both transparent and waterproof. Choose from clear glass, clear acrylic, cotton fabric and tracing paper. Which two qualify?
harder.prompt_hi: Science fair ke liye aise materials chahiye jo transparent aur waterproof dono hon. Clear glass, clear acrylic, cotton fabric aur tracing paper mein se kaun se do chunoge?
hints: Which materials pass both tests, not just one?
Check whether you can see clearly through each and whether water soaks in.
The two materials passing both tests are ___ and ___.
Clear glass and clear acrylic are transparent and do not absorb water.

verified.note: Both name the same two materials

harder.prompt_en: A kabaddi player chooses shoes with rubber soles instead of smooth plastic soles for an indoor court. Why is rubber more suitable? Name the useful property.
harder.prompt_hi: Indoor court ke liye ek kabaddi player smooth plastic soles ke bajay rubber soles wale shoes chunta hai. Rubber zyada suitable kyun hai? Kaam aane wali property batao.
harder.answer: Rubber provides better grip because it has more friction.
hints: What might happen during a quick turn on a smooth court?
Think about how strongly each sole holds the floor.
Rubber is useful because it gives more ___.
Rubber gives better grip, helping the player avoid slipping.

verified.solverAnswer: Rubber provides better grip due to higher friction.

openers.prompt_en: After holding a chilled juice carton, Meera touches her classroom desk and says it feels warm. Her friend says the same desk feels cool. Which is more reliable for checking the desk’s temperature: their hands or a thermometer?
openers.prompt_hi: Thanda juice carton pakadne ke baad Meera ko classroom desk garam lagta hai. Uski dost ko wahi desk thanda lagta hai. Desk ka temperature jaanne ke liye kya zyada bharosemand hai: unke haath ya thermometer?
hints: Why might the two hands give different impressions?
Touch depends partly on what your hand felt just before.
To check the desk’s temperature reliably, use a ___.
A thermometer; unlike touch, it gives a measured reading.

openers.prompt_en: At a school event, one water bottle reads 18 °C and another reads 24 °C on a thermometer. Which bottle’s water is warmer: 18 °C or 24 °C?
openers.prompt_hi: School event mein thermometer par ek water bottle 18 °C aur doosri 24 °C dikhati hai. Kis bottle ka paani zyada garam hai: 18 °C ya 24 °C?
hints: Which reading is higher on the Celsius scale?
A higher temperature means warmer water.
The warmer bottle has the reading ___ °C.
24 °C; it is the higher temperature.

harder.prompt_en: Two students touch the same cricket bat handle. Aarav has just held an ice pack; Zoya has held a warm mug. Will the handle feel warmer to Aarav or Zoya, though its temperature has not changed?
harder.prompt_hi: Do students wahi cricket bat handle chhoote hain. Aarav ne abhi ice pack pakda tha; Zoya ne garam mug. Handle ka temperature badla nahi hai. Kise handle zyada garam lagega: Aarav ko ya Zoya ko?
hints: Whose hand was cooler just before touching the handle?
The same object can feel different depending on your hand’s earlier temperature.
The handle will feel warmer to ___.
Aarav; his hand was cooled by the ice pack.

harder.prompt_en: A thermometer shows drinking water at 16 °C. After the bottle sits in the sun, it reads 29 °C. By how many degrees Celsius did its temperature rise?
harder.prompt_hi: Thermometer par pehle peene ka paani 16 °C tha. Bottle dhoop mein rakhne ke baad reading 29 °C hai. Temperature kitne degree Celsius badha?
hints: Which reading is the starting temperature?
Find the rise by subtracting the earlier reading from the later one.
Temperature rise = 29 − 16 = ___ °C.
13 °C; subtract 16 °C from 29 °C.

harder.prompt_en: A steel lunchbox and a wooden pencil box have spent all morning in the same classroom. The steel feels colder. Why, if both are at room temperature?
harder.prompt_hi: Steel lunchbox aur wooden pencil box poori subah ek hi classroom mein the. Steel zyada thanda lagta hai. Dono room temperature par hain, phir aisa kyun?
harder.answer: Steel transfers heat away from the hand faster than wood.
acceptable: steel conducts heat away from the hand faster
metal takes heat from your hand faster than wood
steel heat ko haath se lakdi se tez le jaata hai
hints: What happens to heat when your hand touches a cooler object?
Different materials transfer heat at different rates.
Steel feels colder because it transfers heat from your hand ___.
Steel carries heat away faster than wood, so your hand feels cooler.

verified.solverAnswer: Steel conducts heat away from the hand faster than wood.

openers.prompt_en: A science club wants to measure a chilled sports drink at about 8 °C. Which should they use: a clinical thermometer or a laboratory thermometer?
openers.prompt_hi: Science club ko lagbhag 8 °C thande sports drink ka temperature naapna hai. Clinical thermometer ya laboratory thermometer—kaunsa use karein?
hints: Is this temperature within both thermometers’ ranges?
Check the lower end of each thermometer’s scale.
The suitable thermometer is the one whose scale includes ___ °C.
Laboratory thermometer; its range includes 8 °C.

openers.prompt_en: On a laboratory thermometer, five equal spaces lie between 10 °C and 20 °C. The liquid ends at the second mark after 10 °C. What is the reading?
openers.prompt_hi: Laboratory thermometer par 10 °C aur 20 °C ke beech paanch barabar spaces hain. Liquid 10 °C ke baad doosre mark tak hai. Reading kya hai?
hints: How much temperature does one space represent?
Divide the difference between the labelled temperatures by the spaces.
Reading = starting mark + (two × ___).
14 °C; each space is 2 °C, so two add 4 °C.

harder.prompt_en: A science club needs to measure both a freezer compartment at −5 °C and warm water at 60 °C. Which one thermometer can measure both: clinical or laboratory?
harder.prompt_hi: Science club ko freezer compartment ka −5 °C aur garam paani ka 60 °C naapna hai. Dono ke liye ek hi kaunsa thermometer chalega: clinical ya laboratory?
hints: Which scale includes both temperatures?
Compare each thermometer’s full range, not just one endpoint.
Both readings fit within the range of the ___ thermometer.
Laboratory thermometer; its range includes both −5 °C and 60 °C.

harder.prompt_en: A laboratory thermometer has five equal spaces from −10 °C to 0 °C. The liquid ends at the third mark after −10 °C. What temperature does it show?
harder.prompt_hi: Laboratory thermometer par −10 °C se 0 °C tak paanch barabar spaces hain. Liquid −10 °C ke baad teesre mark par hai. Temperature kitna hai?
hints: What does one space on this scale represent?
Move towards zero when counting marks from the lower label.
Reading = −10 °C + (three × ___ °C).
−4 °C; three spaces of 2 °C add 6 °C to −10 °C.

harder.prompt_en: Meera lifts a laboratory thermometer out of warm water before noting its reading. Why might the reading no longer show the water’s temperature?
harder.prompt_hi: Meera warm water se laboratory thermometer nikaal kar phir reading note karti hai. Reading ab paani ka temperature sahi kyun nahi dikha sakti?
harder.answer: Its reading can change after it leaves the water.
acceptable: Its temperature changes outside the water
Reading changes when it is taken out
Baahar nikaalne par reading badal sakti hai
hints: What happens to the thermometer after it leaves warm water?
Its reading responds to its surroundings.
Outside the water, the thermometer’s reading may ___.
Its reading can change after removal, so it may not show the water’s temperature.

verified.solverAnswer: It will read room temperature, not the water’s temperature.
verified.note: Solver assumes room temp; key is general change

openers.prompt_en: An ice block is moved from a square lunchbox to a round steel plate without melting. Does it become round or keep its shape?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek ice block ko square lunchbox se round steel plate par rakha gaya, bina pighle. Kya woh round ho jayega ya apni shape rakhega?
hints: Does the plate change the ice block itself?
Think about how a solid behaves in a new container.
Without melting, the block’s shape stays ___.
It keeps its shape because ice is a solid.

openers.prompt_en: On a humid day, tiny water drops appear outside a cold steel tiffin. What change of state forms these drops?
openers.prompt_hi: Humid din par thande steel tiffin ke bahar paani ki chhoti boondein aa jaati hain. Ye boondein kis change of state se banti hain?
hints: Did the drops come through the steel?
Think about water vapour touching a cold surface.
Water vapour changes into liquid; this is called ___.
Condensation: water vapour cools and becomes liquid drops.

harder.prompt_en: A closed, dry jar contains water vapour. It is placed sideways without cooling. Does the vapour occupy only the bottom part or spread through the whole jar? Why?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek band, sukhe jar mein water vapour hai. Use bina thanda kiye sideways rakha gaya. Vapour sirf neeche rahegi ya poore jar mein phailegi? Kyun?
harder.answer: It spreads through the whole jar because a gas fills the available space.
acceptable: whole jar; gases fill available space
poore jar mein; gas saari jagah phailti hai
hints: Would turning the jar create an empty region?
Use the property of gases, not liquids.
The vapour spreads through ___ because a gas fills available space.
It spreads through the whole jar because gases fill available space.

harder.prompt_en: A bottle of water is cooled from 5 °C to −5 °C, then warmed to 5 °C. Name the two changes of state in order.
harder.prompt_hi: Paani ki bottle ko 5 °C se −5 °C tak thanda kiya, phir 5 °C tak garam kiya. Dono changes of state kram se batao.
hints: What happens as water passes its freezing point?
Then consider what warming does to the ice.
Cooling causes ___; warming causes ___.
Freezing, then melting: water becomes ice, then liquid again.

harder.prompt_en: At a railway tea stall, you see a white cloud above hot tea. Is the visible cloud water vapour or tiny liquid droplets? Why?
harder.prompt_hi: Railway tea stall par garam chai ke upar safed baadal dikhta hai. Jo dikh raha hai, woh water vapour hai ya liquid ki chhoti boondein? Kyun?
harder.answer: Tiny liquid droplets; water vapour is invisible.
acceptable: liquid droplets because vapour is invisible
chhoti paani ki boondein; water vapour dikhti nahi
hints: Which state of water can you actually see?
The visible cloud forms when rising vapour cools.
The cloud contains ___; water vapour itself is invisible.
Tiny liquid droplets: cooled vapour condenses, while vapour itself is invisible.

openers.prompt_en: After cricket practice, Meera leaves a damp cap indoors overnight. By morning it is dry, though nobody heated it. What happened to the water at the cap’s surface?
openers.prompt_hi: Cricket practice ke baad Meera apni geeli cap raat bhar ghar ke andar rakhti hai. Subah bina garam kiye cap sookh jaati hai. Cap ki satah par paani ka kya hua?
hints: Could the water leave without boiling?
Think about what happens at a wet surface, even indoors.
At the cap’s surface, liquid water changed into ___.
It evaporated into water vapour; evaporation does not require boiling.

openers.prompt_en: During a school assembly, mist appears on the outside of a cool metal railing when warm, moist air reaches it. Which process forms the tiny water droplets?
openers.prompt_hi: School assembly ke waqt thandi metal railing ke bahar halki boondein dikhne lagti hain, jab garam, nami wali hawa us tak pahunchti hai. Ye boondein kis process se banti hain?
hints: What changes when moist air touches something cool?
Focus on water vapour in the air becoming liquid.
Water vapour cools and forms droplets by ___.
Condensation; cooled water vapour becomes liquid droplets.

harder.prompt_en: Two equal wet cricket jerseys hang indoors. A fan blows across one; the other is in still air. Why will the jersey under the fan dry sooner?
harder.prompt_hi: Do ek jaisi geeli cricket jerseys ghar ke andar latki hain. Ek par fan ki hawa lagti hai; doosri ke paas hawa ruki hai. Fan wali jersey jaldi kyun sookhegi?
harder.answer: Moving air carries away water vapour from the surface, so evaporation is faster.
acceptable: the fan carries away water vapour, increasing evaporation
hints: What happens to the air beside each wet jersey?
Think about vapour collecting near a wet surface.
The fan carries away ___, allowing more water to leave.
Moving air removes water vapour, so evaporation happens faster.

verified.solverAnswer: Faster moving air removes water vapour quickly, speeding up evaporation.

harder.prompt_en: Steam from hot idlis reaches two steel lids: one chilled, one warm. On which lid will more droplets form, and why?
harder.prompt_hi: Garam idliyon ki bhaap do steel lids tak pahunchti hai: ek thanda hai, ek garam. Kis lid par zyada boondein banengi, aur kyun?
harder.answer: On the chilled lid, because water vapour cools and condenses there.
acceptable: chilled lid; vapour cools into droplets
hints: Which lid cools the vapour more?
Droplets form when water vapour loses heat.
More droplets form on the ___ lid because vapour cools there.
The chilled lid; it cools vapour, causing condensation.

verified.solverAnswer: Chilled lid, because it cools steam faster causing more condensation.

harder.prompt_en: After sunshine warms a lake near Pune, clouds form and later bring rain. Name the two processes, in order, that change lake water into vapour and then vapour into cloud droplets.
harder.prompt_hi: Pune ke paas ek lake dhoop se garam hoti hai. Phir badal bante hain aur baad mein baarish hoti hai. Lake ka paani vapour, aur vapour badal ki boondein kis do processes se bante hain? Kram mein batao.
hints: First, how does liquid water leave the lake?
Then consider what happens when rising vapour cools.
Lake water to vapour: ___; vapour to cloud droplets: ___.
Evaporation, then condensation; water becomes vapour before cooling into droplets.

openers.prompt_en: Two identical drops of water fall on a school courtyard: one on a sun-warmed tile, the other on a cool tile in the shade. Which drop evaporates faster?
openers.prompt_hi: School courtyard mein paani ki do ek jaisi boondein girti hain: ek dhoop se garam tile par, doosri chhaon ki thandi tile par. Kaunsi boond jaldi evaporate hogi?
openers.answer: The drop on the sun-warmed tile
hints: Which tile gives the drop more heat?
Temperature affects the rate of evaporation.
The drop on the ___ tile evaporates faster.
The sun-warmed tile: higher temperature speeds up evaporation.

verified.solverAnswer: The drop on the sun-warmed tile evaporates faster.

openers.prompt_en: Aarav wants to test whether moving air makes wet socks dry faster. He hangs two identical wet socks together, with a fan blowing on only one. Should both socks start equally wet or differently wet?
openers.prompt_hi: Aarav test karna chahta hai ki chalti hawa se geele socks jaldi sookhte hain ya nahi. Woh do ek jaise socks saath latkata hai, fan ki hawa sirf ek par lagti hai. Shuru mein dono equally wet hone chahiye ya differently wet?
hints: What should stay the same in a fair comparison?
Change only the air movement, not the starting condition.
Both socks should start ___ wet.
Equally wet: then air movement is the difference being tested.

verified.solverAnswer: Both socks should start equally wet.

harder.prompt_en: After washing, a cricket jersey hangs outdoors on two equally hot days. One day is dry and the other is humid; neither is windy. On which day should it dry faster?
harder.prompt_hi: Dhule hue cricket jersey ko do equally garam din bahar latkaya gaya hai. Ek din hawa dry hai, doosre din humid; dono din hawa nahi chal rahi. Jersey kis din jaldi sookhegi?
hints: Which day has less water vapour already in the air?
Compare humidity; heat and wind are unchanged.
It should dry faster on the ___ day.
The dry day: less humid air allows faster evaporation.

harder.prompt_en: Meera compares evaporation from two bowls. Bowl A has 100 mL water under a fan; Bowl B has 200 mL water away from the fan. Why can't their drying times fairly test the effect of wind?
harder.prompt_hi: Meera do bowls se evaporation compare karti hai. Bowl A mein 100 mL paani fan ke neeche hai; Bowl B mein 200 mL paani fan se door hai. Inke drying times se wind ka effect fairly test kyun nahi hoga?
harder.answer: The starting amounts of water are different
hints: Besides the fan, what else differs?
A fair test changes just one factor.
The starting ___ is not the same.
Water amounts differ, so wind is not the only changed factor.

verified.solverAnswer: Two variables differ: wind and surface area (water volume).

harder.prompt_en: A player wipes their face with a wet towel after kabaddi. The towel soon feels cool against their skin. Why can the drying towel cool the skin?
harder.prompt_hi: Kabaddi ke baad ek player geele towel se chehra ponchta hai. Sookhte waqt towel skin par thanda lagta hai. Sookhta hua towel skin ko thanda kyun kar sakta hai?
harder.answer: Evaporating water takes heat from the skin
acceptable: water takes heat from the skin as it evaporates
evaporation ke liye paani skin se heat leta hai
hints: Where might the drying water get energy?
Evaporation needs heat from the surroundings.
As water evaporates, it takes ___ from the skin.
Evaporating water takes heat from skin, making it feel cooler.

verified.solverAnswer: Evaporation absorbs heat from the skin.

openers.prompt_en: A cook grinds dried coriander seeds into spice powder. Why should she separate the pieces of stalk mixed with the seeds first?
openers.prompt_hi: Cook sukhe dhaniye ke beejon ka powder banayegi. Beejon mein mile danthal ke tukde pehle alag kyun kare?
openers.answer: To keep unwanted stalk pieces out of the spice powder.
acceptable: to get powder without stalk pieces
hints: Which part does the cook want to grind?
Think about what the unwanted pieces would add to the powder.
Separate the stalks so the powder contains only ___.
Remove the stalks so they do not end up in the spice powder.

verified.solverAnswer: Stalk pieces are unwanted and affect taste or texture.

openers.prompt_en: After harvesting wheat, the grains are still attached to the stalks. Which method separates the grains from the stalks: threshing or sieving?
openers.prompt_hi: Gehoon ki katai ke baad daane abhi danthalon se jude hain. Daane alag karne ke liye threshing ya sieving—kaunsa tareeka use hoga?
hints: Are the grains loose or still attached?
One method loosens grains from harvested stalks.
To detach the grains, use ___.
Threshing loosens grains from their stalks.

harder.prompt_en: A flour mill receives maize grains mixed with coarse sand. Why should the mill separate the sand before grinding, even though the flour will be cooked later?
harder.prompt_hi: Flour mill ko makke ke daanon mein moti ret mili hai. Aata baad mein pakna hai, phir bhi peesne se pehle ret alag kyun karein?
harder.answer: Cooking will not remove the sand; it would remain as grit in the flour.
acceptable: sand would remain in the flour
hints: What happens to sand if it goes through the grinder?
Grinding changes piece size; cooking does not take unwanted particles out.
Without separation, the flour would contain ___.
Sand would remain as grit in the flour, even after cooking.

verified.solverAnswer: Sand is hard and can damage the grinding stones or teeth.

harder.prompt_en: Dry husk pieces are nearly the same size as wheat grains but much lighter. To separate them, choose winnowing or sieving. Which difference makes your choice work?
harder.prompt_hi: Sukhe bhusi ke tukde gehoon ke daanon jitne bade hain, par kaafi halke hain. Alag karne ke liye winnowing ya sieving chuno. Tumhara tareeka kis antar par kaam karta hai?
harder.answer: Winnowing; the husk is lighter than the grains.
hints: Would a sieve easily sort pieces of nearly equal size?
Consider which material the moving air carries farther.
Choose ___ because the two parts differ in ___.
Winnowing works because lighter husk blows farther than heavier grains.

verified.solverAnswer: Winnowing; it uses difference in weight, not size.

harder.prompt_en: A farmer has harvested millet heads. The grains must be freed from stalks, then separated from light husk and large pebbles. Put these methods in order: sieving, threshing, winnowing.
harder.prompt_hi: Kisan ke paas kate hue bajre ke sish hain. Daanon ko pehle danthalon se, phir halki bhusi aur bade kankaron se alag karna hai. Sahi kram batao: sieving, threshing, winnowing.
hints: Which task must happen before sorting loose grains?
Match each later unwanted material to weight or size.
First ___, then ___, finally ___.
Threshing frees grains; winnowing removes light husk; sieving removes large pebbles.

openers.prompt_en: After rinsing a paintbrush, Meera leaves a jar of water undisturbed. Heavy paint particles settle at the bottom. Which method lets her transfer the clearer water without disturbing them?
openers.prompt_hi: Paintbrush dhone ke baad Meera paani ka jar bina hilaye rakhti hai. Bhaari paint ke kan neeche baith jaate hain. Unhe bina hilaye upar ka saaf paani nikaalne ke liye kaunsi method use karegi?
acceptable: gently pouring off the clearer water
upar ka paani dheere se undelna
hints: Which part of the jar would Meera transfer?
The particles have already settled; no filter is needed.
She can gently pour the upper liquid into another jar: ___.
Decantation: gently pour off the clearer liquid above settled particles.

openers.prompt_en: A school lab has water mixed with fine, insoluble chalk powder. Which should students use to separate the powder: filter paper or a shallow plate in the sun?
openers.prompt_hi: School lab mein paani mein bareek, na ghulne wala chalk powder mila hai. Powder alag karne ke liye students kya use karein: filter paper ya dhoop mein rakhi chhichhli plate?
hints: Does the chalk dissolve in the water?
Choose what can hold back undissolved particles while water passes through.
The water passes through ___, leaving the powder behind.
Filter paper traps insoluble chalk powder while water passes through.

harder.prompt_en: A cricket ground's water bucket contains heavy sand. The groundskeeper leaves it untouched, then gently pours the clearer water into another bucket. Name the two separation methods in order.
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket ground ke paani ki bucket mein bhaari ret hai. Groundskeeper use bina hilaye rakhta hai, phir upar ka saaf paani dheere se doosri bucket mein undelta hai. Dono separation methods kram se batao.
acceptable: sand settling, then pouring off the water
hints: What happens to sand while the bucket rests?
One method happens during rest; the other happens while pouring.
First the sand ___; next the upper water is ___.
Sedimentation settles the sand; decantation pours off the clearer water.

harder.prompt_en: Riya pours water containing fine, insoluble charcoal powder through filter paper. Why does the powder remain on the paper while water collects below?
harder.prompt_hi: Riya bareek, na ghulne wala charcoal powder mila paani filter paper se guzaarti hai. Powder paper par kyun reh jaata hai, jabki paani neeche jama hota hai?
harder.answer: The filter paper traps the insoluble particles but lets water pass through.
acceptable: charcoal particles cannot pass through the filter, but water can
filter powder rokta hai aur paani guzarne deta hai
hints: Is the charcoal dissolved or present as particles?
Think about what can pass through the filter paper.
