The paper holds back ___ but allows ___ through.
The paper traps insoluble charcoal particles while water passes through.

verified.solverAnswer: Filter paper pores are smaller than charcoal particles, so water passes through but particles are trapped.

harder.prompt_en: A cook dissolves sugar completely in water and passes it through filter paper. To get the sugar back, should she filter it again or evaporate the water? Give the reason.
harder.prompt_hi: Ek cook cheeni ko paani mein poori tarah gholkar filter paper se guzaarti hai. Cheeni wapas paane ke liye dobara filter kare ya paani evaporate kare? Wajah bhi batao.
harder.answer: Evaporate the water; dissolved sugar passes through filter paper but remains when water evaporates.
acceptable: evaporation, because a filter cannot trap dissolved sugar
paani sukhana; ghuli cheeni filter se nikal jaati hai
hints: Where is the sugar after the first filtering?
A filter traps undissolved particles, not a dissolved substance.
Remove the ___ from the solution to leave the sugar behind.
Evaporate the water; dissolved sugar passes through a filter but stays behind.

verified.solverAnswer: Evaporate the water, because sugar dissolves fully and passes through filter paper, so filtration cannot separate it.

openers.prompt_en: A science club keeps sprouting moong seeds in a closed jar. After some time, the amount of oxygen inside falls. Which life process of the seeds uses oxygen?
openers.prompt_hi: Science club ne ankurit moong ke beej band jar mein rakhe. Kuch der baad jar mein oxygen kam ho gayi. Beejon ki kaunsi jeevan-prakriya oxygen istemal karti hai?
hints: What might the seeds be doing with the oxygen?
Think of the process living things use to release energy.
The seeds use oxygen to release energy through ____.
Respiration: the seeds use oxygen to release energy.

openers.prompt_en: A voice-controlled robot moves when Aarav speaks, but it never grows or makes new robots. Is it living or non-living?
openers.prompt_hi: Aarav ki awaaz sunkar ek robot chalta hai, lekin woh na badhta hai, na naye robot banata hai. Kya woh living hai ya non-living?
hints: Is responding to a voice enough to decide?
Check other characteristics of living things too.
The robot responds, but lacks other living characteristics; it is ____.
Non-living: one life-like action does not make it living.

harder.prompt_en: After kabaddi practice, Meera's body removes some waste substances through sweat. Which characteristic of living things does this show?
harder.prompt_hi: Kabaddi practice ke baad Meera ka sharir paseene ke zariye kuch waste substances bahar nikalta hai. Yeh living things ki kaunsi khasiyat dikhata hai?
hints: What is leaving Meera's body?
Focus on what happens to substances the body does not need.
This shows the characteristic of getting rid of ____.
Getting rid of wastes: sweat carries some waste substances out.

harder.prompt_en: A salt crystal gets bigger in salty water. It does not respire or reproduce. Is the crystal living or non-living? Give the key reason.
harder.prompt_hi: Namak ka crystal namkeen paani mein bada ho jata hai. Woh respire ya reproduce nahi karta. Crystal living hai ya non-living? Mukhya wajah batao.
harder.answer: Non-living; getting bigger alone is not enough to show it is living.
acceptable: non-living because it lacks other living characteristics
nirjeev; sirf bada hona kaafi nahi hai
hints: Can getting bigger alone settle the question?
Check its other life processes as well.
Growth alone is not enough; the crystal is ____.
Non-living: getting bigger alone does not show all living characteristics.

verified.solverAnswer: Non-living, because it does not show all life processes like respiration or reproduction.

harder.prompt_en: A dry bean seed in a packet shows no visible growth. After it gets water, it sprouts. Was the seed living before it was watered? Give the key reason.
harder.prompt_hi: Packet mein rakha sukha bean seed badhta hua nahi dikhta. Paani milne par woh ankurit hota hai. Kya paani milne se pehle beej living tha? Mukhya wajah batao.
harder.answer: Yes; it was dormant and could grow when conditions became suitable.
acceptable: haan, woh nishkriya tha aur sahi haalaat mein ug sakta tha
hints: Does no visible growth mean it cannot grow later?
Think about what changes when the seed gets water.
The seed was ____ and could grow under suitable conditions.
Yes: it was dormant and sprouted when conditions became suitable.

verified.solverAnswer: Yes, because it was dormant but alive, showing potential for growth when conditions became favourable.

openers.prompt_en: A school science club puts chana seeds on damp cotton in an open container in a warm classroom. Which needed germination condition does the damp cotton provide: water, air or warmth?
openers.prompt_hi: School science club chane ke beej geeli cotton par, khule container mein, garam classroom mein rakhta hai. Geeli cotton germination ke liye kya deti hai: paani, hawa ya garmahat?
hints: What does the cotton have that dry cotton lacks?
Think about what a seed absorbs before sprouting.
Damp cotton provides ____.
Water; the seed absorbs it before sprouting.

openers.prompt_en: Meera tests whether warmth affects rajma germination. Both plates have equal seeds on damp cotton; one stays in a warm room, the other in a cool room. Should she use the same or different amounts of water?
openers.prompt_hi: Meera check karti hai ki garmahat rajma ke germination par asar karti hai ya nahi. Dono plates mein barabar beej geeli cotton par hain; ek garam room mein, doosri thande room mein. Paani ki matra same rakhe ya different?
hints: What is the one condition Meera wants to change?
Keep other conditions alike so the comparison is fair.
The water amounts should be ____.
Same; then warmth is the condition being tested.

harder.prompt_en: For a school exhibition, Aarav keeps soaked peas fully submerged in a sealed jar and equally soaked peas on damp cotton in an open jar. Both stay warm. Which jar's seeds are more likely to germinate: sealed or open?
harder.prompt_hi: School exhibition ke liye Aarav bhigoye matar sealed jar mein poori tarah paani ke neeche rakhta hai, aur utne hi bhigoye matar open jar mein geeli cotton par. Dono garam jagah hain. Kis jar ke beej zyada ankurit honge: sealed ya open?
hints: Which seeds can get what they need from their surroundings?
Seeds need access to air as well as moisture.
The ____ jar offers better access to air.
Open jar; its seeds can get air without being submerged.

harder.prompt_en: To test whether air affects moong germination, Kabir puts seeds underwater in a fridge and seeds on damp cotton in a warm room. Is his test fair: yes or no? Name the other condition he changed.
harder.prompt_hi: Air ka moong germination par asar check karne ke liye Kabir kuch beej fridge mein paani ke neeche rakhta hai aur kuch garam room mein geeli cotton par. Kya test fair hai: yes ya no? Air ke alawa badli hui ek condition batao.
hints: Did Kabir change only the condition he wanted to test?
Compare where the two sets are kept.
The test is ____; he also changed ____.
No; he changed temperature too, so air's effect is unclear.

harder.prompt_en: Moong seeds sprout on damp cotton inside a dark cupboard. A week later, the seedlings are pale. Why should they now be moved into light?
harder.prompt_hi: Moong ke beej andheri cupboard mein geeli cotton par ankurit ho jaate hain. Ek hafte baad naye paudhe peele dikhte hain. Ab unhe roshni mein kyun rakhna chahiye?
harder.answer: Seedlings need light to make food by photosynthesis.
acceptable: roshni se apna bhojan banane ke liye
hints: What must a growing seedling do after its stored food runs low?
Think about what green leaves use to make food.
Move them into light so they can ____.
They need light to make food by photosynthesis.

verified.solverAnswer: For photosynthesis to make food and become green.

openers.prompt_en: A sunflower seed sprouts in the school garden. What comes next in its life cycle: a seedling or a flower?
openers.prompt_hi: School garden mein sunflower ka beej ankurit hua. Uske life cycle mein agla stage kya hoga: seedling ya flower?
hints: What does the sprout grow into first?
Think of the young plant before it can reproduce.
Sprouted seed → ___ → mature plant
Seedling; it grows before the plant produces flowers.

openers.prompt_en: A student finds mosquito wrigglers in water standing in a bucket. Which stage are the wrigglers: larva or pupa?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek student ko balti mein jama paani mein machhar ke wrigglers dikhte hain. Yeh kaunsa stage hai: larva ya pupa?
hints: Which stage moves like a wriggler?
Recall the stage that follows a mosquito egg.
Egg → ___ → pupa → adult
Larva; mosquito eggs hatch into wriggling larvae in water.

harder.prompt_en: A marigold plant has flowers but no fruits yet. If pollination succeeds, which two stages will follow, in order: fruit then seed, or seed then fruit?
harder.prompt_hi: Gende ke paudhe par phool hain, lekin abhi phal nahi hain. Pollination safal ho, toh agle do stages kis kram mein honge: fruit phir seed, ya seed phir fruit?
hints: What develops from a pollinated flower?
Think about where the new seeds develop.
Flower → ___ → seeds inside
Fruit then seed; the fruit develops and contains seeds.

harder.prompt_en: Mosquito eggs are found in water collected on a terrace. The water is emptied before any adults emerge. Which two stages that normally follow the eggs cannot develop there?
harder.prompt_hi: Chhat par jama paani mein machhar ke ande mile. Adult machhar nikalne se pehle paani khaali kar diya gaya. Andon ke baad aane wale kaunse do stages wahan develop nahi ho paayenge?
hints: Which stages come between egg and adult?
Recall the two immature stages linked to water.
Egg → ___ → ___ → adult
Larva and pupa; both stages develop in water before adulthood.

harder.prompt_en: A tadpole develops legs and lungs as it becomes a frog. Why is this change called metamorphosis: because its body form changes greatly, or because it simply grows bigger?
harder.prompt_hi: Tadpole ke pair aur lungs bante hain jab woh frog banta hai. Is badlav ko metamorphosis kyun kehte hain: kyunki uske sharir ka roop kaafi badalta hai, ya kyunki woh bas bada hota hai?
acceptable: sharir ka roop kaafi badalta hai
hints: Is the change only in size?
Compare the tadpole’s body parts with the adult frog’s.
Metamorphosis means a major change in body ___.
Its body form changes greatly; it is not merely growing bigger.

verified.solverAnswer: because its body form changes greatly

openers.prompt_en: A school garden has sunlight, soil and a plastic watering can. Which two are natural resources?
openers.prompt_hi: School garden mein sunlight, mitti aur plastic ka watering can hai. Inmein se kaun si do cheezein prakritik sansaadhan hain?
hints: Which things were not made in a factory?
Natural resources come from nature and are useful.
Choose the two things that come from nature: ___ and ___.
Sunlight and soil: both come from nature and help plants grow.

openers.prompt_en: A metro station uses wind, electricity from a wall socket and stone. Which two are natural resources?
openers.prompt_hi: Metro station par hawa, wall socket se bijli aur patthar use hote hain. Inmein se kaun se do prakritik sansaadhan hain?
hints: Which items occur in nature?
Separate things found in nature from supplied power.
The two things found in nature are ___ and ___.
Wind and stone: both occur in nature.

harder.prompt_en: A cricket ground uses rainwater collected in a tank and water made by melting ice bought from a shop. Is only the free rainwater a natural resource, or is the water in both cases a natural resource? Why?
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket ground par tank mein jama baarish ka paani aur dukaan se kharidi baraf pighlakar bana paani use hota hai. Kya sirf muft baarish ka paani prakritik sansaadhan hai, ya dono ka paani? Kyun?
harder.answer: Water in both cases; paying for or storing it does not change its natural origin.
acceptable: both, because water comes from nature
dono ka paani, kyunki paani prakriti se milta hai
hints: Does buying something change where it originally comes from?
Judge the material’s origin, not its price or container.
In both cases, the material is ___; its origin is ___.
Both: water is a natural resource even when stored or sold.

verified.solverAnswer: Water in both cases is a natural resource. Because water, whether from rain or ice, originates from nature.

harder.prompt_en: After trees are cleared from a steep hillside, heavy rain washes mud onto a village road. Which forest use would have helped reduce this problem?
harder.prompt_hi: Dhalaan wali pahaadi se ped hata diye gaye. Tez baarish mein mitti behkar gaon ki sadak par aa gayi. Jungle ka kaunsa kaam is samasya ko kam karta?
harder.answer: Tree roots hold soil in place and reduce soil erosion.
acceptable: pedon ki jadein mitti ko baandhe rakhti hain
hints: What was keeping the hillside covered before clearing?
Think about what remains below ground when trees grow.
Tree ___ help keep the ___ in place.
Tree roots hold soil in place, reducing erosion during rain.

verified.solverAnswer: Forests slow water runoff and prevent soil erosion.

harder.prompt_en: Two identical deflated footballs balance on a simple scale. One is inflated and placed back on its side. Which side goes down: inflated football, deflated football or neither?
harder.prompt_hi: Do ek jaise, bina hawa wale football simple scale par balance hain. Ek mein hawa bharkar use wapas usi taraf rakha gaya. Kaunsi taraf neeche jayegi: hawa bhara football, bina hawa wala football, ya koi bhi nahi?
hints: What was added to just one football?
A balance responds to added weight.
Adding air makes that side ___ than before.
Inflated football: the added air has weight.

openers.prompt_en: A school uses bamboo grown again after harvesting and iron ore dug from a mine. Which is renewable: bamboo or iron ore?
openers.prompt_hi: School dobara ugne wala bamboo aur khadaan se nikla iron ore use karta hai. Inmein renewable kaunsa hai: bamboo ya iron ore?
hints: Which resource can be replaced after it is used?
Think about regrowth compared with material taken from a mine.
The resource that can grow again is ___.
Bamboo is renewable because it can grow again after harvesting.

openers.prompt_en: A village pond receives rain each year, but people take out more water than rain replaces. Will its water level rise or fall over several years?
openers.prompt_hi: Gaon ke talab mein har saal baarish ka paani aata hai, par log usse zyada paani nikaalte hain. Kai saalon mein paani ka level badhega ya ghatega?
hints: Compare how much enters the pond with how much leaves.
Even a replenished resource changes when use exceeds replacement.
When more leaves than enters, the level will ___.
It will fall because people remove more water than rain replaces.

harder.prompt_en: A canteen can cook using biogas made regularly from food waste or LPG obtained from underground deposits. Which fuel is renewable: biogas or LPG?
harder.prompt_hi: Canteen khane ke bache tukdon se regularly bani biogas ya zameen ke neeche ke bhandaar se mili LPG use kar sakti hai. Renewable fuel kaunsa hai: biogas ya LPG?
hints: Which fuel has a source that can be produced again soon?
Compare fresh food waste with underground fuel deposits.
The fuel made from repeatedly available waste is ___.
Biogas is renewable because new food waste can be used to make more.

harder.prompt_en: Fish reproduce in a lake, yet catches get smaller each year after too many fish are caught. Why can this renewable resource still run low?
harder.prompt_hi: Jheel mein machhliyan bachche deti hain, phir bhi bahut zyada machhliyan pakadne ke baad har saal catch kam hota hai. Yeh renewable resource phir bhi kam kyun ho sakta hai?
harder.answer: Fish are caught faster than they reproduce.
acceptable: more fish are caught than are born
jitni nayi machhliyan hoti hain usse zyada pakdi jaati hain
hints: Compare the number caught with the number of new fish.
Reproduction replaces fish, but replacement has a rate.
The population shrinks when fish are caught faster than they ___.
Fish run low because they are caught faster than they reproduce.

verified.solverAnswer: Use exceeds the rate of reproduction, depleting the population.

harder.prompt_en: A school garden has limited water. For the same plants, should it use a hose that sprays the whole path or drip pipes that deliver water near roots? Choose the wiser method.
harder.prompt_hi: School garden mein paani limited hai. Wahi paudhon ke liye poore raaste par spray karne wali hose use karein ya jadon ke paas paani dene wali drip pipes? Samajhdari wala tareeka chuno.
hints: Where do the plants need the water most?
Choose the method that sends less water to places without plants.
Water delivered near the ___ avoids wetting the whole path.
Drip pipes are wiser because they deliver water near roots with less waste.

openers.prompt_en: In a school astronomy photo, a star looks like a tiny dot. Is it actually tiny, or does it look tiny because it is extremely far away?
openers.prompt_hi: School ki astronomy photo mein ek taara chhote se dot jaisa dikhta hai. Kya woh sach mein chhota hai, ya bahut door hone ki wajah se chhota dikhta hai?
openers.answer: It looks tiny because it is extremely far away.
acceptable: Door hone ki wajah se chhota dikhta hai
hints: Can an object's appearance tell you its actual size?
Think about how distance affects apparent size.
It looks tiny because its distance is ___.
It looks tiny because it is extremely far away.

verified.solverAnswer: It looks tiny because it is extremely far away.

openers.prompt_en: At a school stargazing event, Meera spots Saptarishi's two pointer stars. She extends an imaginary line through them to locate a useful direction-finding star. Which star is she looking for: Pole Star or Sirius?
openers.prompt_hi: School ke stargazing event mein Meera ko Saptarishi ke do pointer stars dikhte hain. Woh unke through ek imaginary line badhati hai. Direction jaanne ke liye woh kaunsa taara dhoondh rahi hai: Pole Star ya Sirius?
hints: What are Saptarishi's pointer stars used to locate?
Think of the star used to find north.
The imaginary line leads towards the ___ Star.
Pole Star; Saptarishi's pointer stars help locate it.

harder.prompt_en: During a science quiz, Rohan says, 'The Sun looks bigger than the stars we see at night, so it must be bigger than every star.' What is the main flaw in his reasoning?
harder.prompt_hi: Science quiz mein Rohan kehta hai, 'Suraj raat ke taaron se bada dikhta hai, toh woh har taare se bada hoga.' Uski reasoning mein mukhya galti kya hai?
harder.answer: He ignores distance: the Sun looks bigger because it is much closer to Earth.
acceptable: Distance affects how big stars look
Suraj Dharti ke zyada paas hai
hints: Does looking bigger always mean being bigger?
Apparent size also depends on distance.
The Sun looks bigger because it is much ___.
The Sun is much closer; appearance alone cannot prove its actual size.

verified.solverAnswer: The Sun is much closer to us.

harder.prompt_en: At a Jaipur skywatch, one group of stars looks like a large ladle with seven bright stars. Two stars at the outer edge of its bowl point towards the Pole Star. Name the group.
harder.prompt_hi: Jaipur skywatch mein saat chamakte taaron ka ek group badi kalchhi jaisa dikhta hai. Uske bowl ke baahari kinare ke do taare Pole Star ki taraf point karte hain. Group ka naam batao.
hints: Which star pattern has a bowl and a handle?
Its bowl contains the pointer stars.
This seven-star pattern is called ___.
Saptarishi; its bowl has the two pointer stars.

harder.prompt_en: From a terrace, Aditi sees stars shift position through the night, while the Pole Star seems nearly fixed. Why do the other stars seem to move?
harder.prompt_hi: Terrace se Aditi dekhti hai ki raat bhar taare apni jagah badalte dikhte hain, lekin Pole Star lagbhag ek jagah rehta hai. Baaki taare move karte hue kyun dikhte hain?
harder.answer: Because Earth rotates on its axis.
acceptable: Dharti apni dhuri par ghoomti hai
Prithvi ke ghoomne ki wajah se
hints: Could the observer be moving without noticing?
Think about what Earth does once each day.
The stars seem to move because Earth ___.
Earth rotates on its axis, making most stars appear to shift.

verified.solverAnswer: Earth's rotation makes stars appear to move.

openers.prompt_en: A school display places Earth and Jupiter on a line in their order from the Sun. Which planet must go between them?
openers.prompt_hi: School display mein Earth aur Jupiter ko Suraj se unke kram mein rakha hai. Inke beech kaunsa grah aayega?
hints: Can you recall the planets just after Earth?
Think of their order moving outward from the Sun.
Earth, ___, Jupiter.
Mars goes between Earth and Jupiter in the planets’ order.

openers.prompt_en: Two science-club posters show Earth and Jupiter as circles. To show their real sizes, which circle should be larger: Earth’s or Jupiter’s?
openers.prompt_hi: Science club ke do posters mein Earth aur Jupiter circles se dikhaye hain. Asli size dikhane ke liye kiska circle bada hona chahiye—Earth ka ya Jupiter ka?
hints: Which of these planets has the greater size?
Recall how Earth’s size compares with the giant planets.
The larger circle should represent ___.
Jupiter’s circle should be larger because Jupiter is bigger than Earth.

harder.prompt_en: A quiz asks for a planet that is both bigger than Earth and farther from the Sun than Earth. Choose one: Venus, Mars, or Saturn.
harder.prompt_hi: Quiz mein aisa grah chahiye jo Earth se bada bhi ho aur Suraj se Earth ke muqable zyada door bhi ho. Chuno: Venus, Mars ya Saturn.
hints: Which options lie farther from the Sun than Earth?
Now compare those planets’ sizes with Earth’s.
Farther away and bigger than Earth: ___.
Saturn fits both conditions; Mars is smaller, while Venus is nearer.

harder.prompt_en: At a night-sky event, a student says, ‘Venus is bright, so it must make its own light like a star.’ What makes Venus appear bright?
harder.prompt_hi: Night-sky event mein ek student kehta hai, ‘Venus bright hai, toh star ki tarah apni light banata hoga.’ Venus bright kyon dikhta hai?
acceptable: Suraj ki roshni reflect karta hai
hints: Does a planet produce light as a star does?
Think about where a planet’s visible light begins.
Venus appears bright because it ___ sunlight.
Venus reflects sunlight; it does not make its own light.

harder.prompt_en: In January, Earth is near its closest point to the Sun, yet Delhi has winter. Why can’t Earth’s distance from the Sun be the main cause of seasons? Give the key idea.
harder.prompt_hi: January mein Earth Suraj ke lagbhag sabse paas hoti hai, phir bhi Delhi mein sardi hoti hai. Suraj se doori seasons ki main wajah kyon nahi ho sakti? Mukhya idea batao.
harder.answer: Earth’s tilted axis changes how directly sunlight reaches a place during the year.
acceptable: Seasons are caused mainly by Earth’s axial tilt
Earth’s tilt changes the angle of sunlight
Earth ke axis ka jhukav sunlight ka angle badalta hai
hints: What changes the sunlight Delhi receives during the year?
Consider the direction Earth’s axis points as it orbits.
The main cause is Earth’s ___, which changes sunlight’s angle.
Earth’s axial tilt changes sunlight’s angle; distance is not the main cause.

verified.solverAnswer: Earth's tilt causes seasons, not distance.

openers.prompt_en: At a school astronomy camp, Meera sees a faint band stretching across the dark sky. Is she seeing part of the Milky Way or a cloud in Earth’s atmosphere?
openers.prompt_hi: School astronomy camp mein Meera ko andhere aasman mein ek halki si patti dikhti hai. Kya woh Milky Way ka hissa dekh rahi hai ya Earth ke atmosphere ka baadal?
hints: What can appear as a faint band on a dark night?
Think about how our galaxy appears from Earth.
The faint band is part of our ____.
It is the Milky Way; its many distant stars make the band.

openers.prompt_en: A space app zooms out from Earth to show the Sun and its planets together. Which larger structure contains this whole group: the Milky Way or Earth?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek space app Earth se zoom out karke Sun aur uske planets ko saath dikhata hai. Is poore group ko kaun-si badi structure sametati hai: Milky Way ya Earth?
hints: What do the Sun and its planets form?
That group lies inside a much larger collection of stars.
The Sun’s group is inside the ____.
The Milky Way contains our solar system.

harder.prompt_en: A poster calls the faint Milky Way band ‘one enormous star’. Is ‘one star’ or ‘billions of stars’ the better description of what makes the band?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek poster Milky Way ki halki patti ko ‘ek bahut bada star’ kehta hai. Patti kis se bani hai: ‘ek star’ ya ‘arbon stars’?
hints: Can a galaxy contain just one star?
Think about what a galaxy contains.
The band comes from light of ____.
Billions of stars; their combined light appears as a faint band.

harder.prompt_en: A quiz lists Earth, the Sun, the solar system, the Milky Way and the universe. Starting at the Sun, name the next two larger structures in order.
harder.prompt_hi: Quiz mein Earth, Sun, solar system, Milky Way aur universe diye hain. Sun se shuru karke agle do bade structures kram mein batao.
hints: What group includes the Sun and its planets?
That group is inside our galaxy.
Solar system, then Milky Way; each contains the previous one.

harder.prompt_en: During a power cut in Jaipur, Riya sees more stars than usual. Why were fewer stars visible when streetlights were on? Answer with the key idea.
harder.prompt_hi: Jaipur mein power cut ke dauraan Riya ko aam dino se zyada stars dikhte hain. Streetlights jalne par kam stars kyun dikhte the? Mukhya wajah batao.
harder.answer: Streetlight pollution brightens the sky and hides faint stars.
acceptable: streetlights make the sky too bright to see faint stars
hints: Which stars are hardest to spot in a bright sky?
Compare the sky’s brightness with faint starlight.
Streetlights brighten the sky, so ____ are harder to see.
Streetlight pollution hides faint stars by brightening the sky.

verified.solverAnswer: Bright streetlights cause light pollution, making dim stars invisible.
